name: roblox-mcp-dashboard
description: Auto-opens the Roblox MCP dashboard in a VS Code tab whenever a Roblox client connects.

robloxMcpDashboard.port.description: Port the roblox-mcp dashboard HTTP server listens on. Must match ROBLOX_MCP_PORT if you've changed it from the default.

robloxMcpDashboard.pollIntervalMs.description: How often (ms) to poll /api/status to detect Roblox client connections.

robloxMcpDashboard.autoOpen.description: Automatically open the dashboard tab when a Roblox client connects (and no tab is currently open).
